instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific dependencies: `yarn add lucide-react framer-motion @radix-ui/react-navigation-menu clsx tailwind-merge`
Use Manrope for headings and Inter for body text.
Implement the 8-category mega menu using Shadcn's NavigationMenu. Include: VAPT/Cyber, Compliance/GRC, Deep Tech & AI, Digital Transformation, IoT/OT, Green Energy/ESG, Startup, Training.
Design sections with an Enterprise/Swiss aesthetic: sharp corners (`rounded-sm`), 1px borders, high-contrast typography, and generous spacing.

The Hero section must feature the `hero_background` image with a suitable overlay to maintain text readability. Use `bg-white/90` or `bg-slate-900/60` depending on the block theme, but ensure strict APCA contrast.
Use the `dashboard_mockup` image in the 'Deep Tech & AI' or 'Digital Transformation' sections to highlight technical excellence.
Testimonial sections should utilize the professional portrait images provided, maintaining an authoritative, C-suite tone.
Add `data-testid` to all actionable components (buttons, links, inputs).
Avoid over-animation; stick to subtle `framer-motion` enter animations (fade up) and hover state color transitions.
